meta.price_basis: Azure list prices from the Azure Retail Prices API (USD, pay-as-you-go, no EA/MCA discount), swedencentral meters; Azure OpenAI at Data Zone (EU) Standard rates; retrieved 2026-11-17. Communications (voice legs, chat, SMS, e-mail) are priced at Azure Communication Services list rates as a proxy for whichever provider carries them; SMS rates from Microsoft Learn.
meta.reference_customer: Contoso Home Retail (fictional): 1,500 agents (about 60 % voice capacity / 40 % digital), about 18 M contacts per year, 8 markets
meta.disclaimer: Illustrative and assumption-driven. Every figure flagged validate=true must be replaced with the customer's own data before the case is used for a commitment.

scenario_definitions.conservative: Uncertain outcome and cost assumptions (AI containment, AHT reduction, adoption speed, ramps, confidence factors, one-time and AI-operations costs) move 60 % of the way from base to their unfavourable bound; customer facts, Azure usage drivers and prices stay at base.
scenario_definitions.upside: Uncertain outcome and cost assumptions move 60 % of the way from base to their favourable bound; customer facts, Azure usage drivers and prices stay at base.
scenario_definitions.stacked_downside: Stress test, not a forecast: every uncertain outcome and cost assumption at its unfavourable bound simultaneously (100 % of the distance).
scenario_definitions.stacked_upside: Stress test, not a forecast: every uncertain outcome and cost assumption at its favourable bound simultaneously.

meta.communications_note: Azure Communication Services is being retired as a standalone offering effective 30 September 2028 (Microsoft Learn retirement guide, announced 23 September 2026); customers without an ACS resource created before 23 October 2026 cannot acquire ACS phone numbers or SMS. Concierge therefore treats telephony and messaging as pluggable (SIP trunk to the Azure OpenAI Realtime SIP endpoint, Teams Phone Extensibility, Dynamics 365 Contact Center, partner CPaaS). The communications cost is a real customer cost and is priced at ACS list rates as a proxy, but by default 0 % of it is counted as Azure consumed revenue (comms_azure_billed_share).

retrieval.notes: Every unit price that has a price_ref is reproduced in pricing_snapshot.json (exact API rows) and verified by test_model.py. Prices without price_ref (SMS, private endpoints) cite Microsoft Learn or are flagged as assumptions.

tiers.rationale: Discrete infrastructure configurations step up with the number of seats whose contacts run AI-first (seats x adoption). Continuous items (search replicas, Fabric capacity, Cosmos RU/s, vCPU, Event Hubs units) are sized from peak load inside the model.

agents.label: Contact-center agents (seats)
agents.rationale: Reference customer size from the product brief.
agents.source: Brief: Contoso Home Retail reference customer (fictional).

contacts_per_year.label: Contacts per year (all channels)
contacts_per_year.rationale: About 12,000 contacts per agent per year, consistent with 1,500 agents at 80-85 % occupancy and a blended 5.2 effective handling minutes per contact.
contacts_per_year.source: Brief: about 18 M contacts per year.

voice_share_of_contacts.label: Voice share of contacts
voice_share_of_contacts.rationale: Brief states about 60 % of agent capacity on voice; voice contacts are longer, so voice is about half of contacts. Digital = 1 - voice.
voice_share_of_contacts.source: Brief (60/40 capacity split); contact split is an assumption.

aht_voice_min.label: Voice average handle time (talk + wrap-up)
aht_voice_min.rationale: Typical retail/e-commerce service voice AHT of 5-8 minutes.
aht_voice_min.source: Assumption; replace with the ACD report.

aht_digital_effective_min.label: Digital effective agent minutes per contact
aht_digital_effective_min.rationale: Chat/messaging/e-mail handle time of about 9.6 minutes at an average concurrency of 2.5. With voice at 6.5 minutes, 1,500 agents handle about 18 M contacts.

loaded_cost_per_agent_usd.label: Fully-loaded annual cost per agent
loaded_cost_per_agent_usd.rationale: About 52,000 salary and on-costs (blended across 8 European markets incl. nearshore) + 18 % supervision, QA, WFM and training overhead + 3,000 seat technology + 3,000 facilities = about 67,400. Excludes recruiting and onboarding (modelled under attrition). Cross-check: the derived cost per contact (about $5.6) sits below the $8.01 live-channel average that Gartner reported in 2019, i.e. conservative.
loaded_cost_per_agent_usd.source: Assumption; cross-check Gartner press release 19 Aug 2019 ($8.01 live vs $0.10 self-service per contact).

variable_cost_share.label: Share of loaded cost that scales with headcount
variable_cost_share.rationale: Salaries, on-costs, seat licences and part of supervision move with headcount over three years (via attrition and hiring freezes); facilities and fixed management do not. Only this share is counted as cashable.

attrition_rate.label: Agent attrition (annual)
attrition_rate.rationale: Brief states 35-45 %. ContactBabel's US survey (year-end 2023, 189 centers) reports a 31 % mean and 24 % median, so 40 % is above the US mean (retail, multi-country, seasonal) and must be validated.
attrition_rate.source: Brief; ContactBabel US Contact Center Decision-Makers' Guide 2024 edition (secondary citation).

replacement_cost_usd.label: Cost to replace one leaver (recruit, onboard, train, ramp)
replacement_cost_usd.rationale: Recruiting and onboarding cost plus 4-6 weeks of reduced productivity; excludes salary during productive time.

agents_per_qa_analyst.label: Agents per QA analyst
agents_per_qa_analyst.rationale: Typical QA span of 1:20 to 1:40; at 1:30 the reference customer has 50 QA analysts reviewing 1-3 % of contacts.

qa_analyst_cost_usd.label: Fully-loaded annual cost per QA analyst

qa_coverage_baseline.label: Manual QA coverage today
qa_coverage_baseline.rationale: Brief states 1-3 %. Vendor sources commonly cite 1-3 % manual QA coverage; there is no regulated benchmark.
qa_coverage_baseline.source: Brief; QA-software vendors (e.g. RingCentral QA guide) - vendor-reported.

repeat_contact_share.label: Repeat contacts (same issue within 7 days)
repeat_contact_share.rationale: Equivalent to roughly 88 % first-contact resolution; also used to express human cost per resolved contact.

contacts_per_customer.label: Contacts per contacting customer per year
contacts_per_customer.rationale: Used to size the customer base exposed to better service (6 M customers).

gross_margin_per_customer_usd.label: Annual gross margin per contacting customer
gross_margin_per_customer_usd.rationale: Home-retail average revenue per customer of about 280 at about 30 % gross margin.

overflow_share_of_contacts.label: Contacts handled by overflow / seasonal outsourcing
overflow_share_of_contacts.rationale: Retail peaks (promotions, holiday delivery failures) push a few percent of annual volume to BPO overflow or seasonal staff.

overflow_premium_usd_per_contact.label: Overflow cost premium over in-house cost per contact
overflow_premium_usd_per_contact.rationale: About $7.4 outsourced vs about $5.6 in-house; only the premium is counted (in-house cost is in the containment benefit).

compliance_incidents_per_year.label: Compliance-relevant incidents per year
compliance_incidents_per_year.rationale: Missed disclosures, mis-statements, data-handling slips that lead to complaints, remediation or regulatory contact.

compliance_cost_per_incident_usd.label: Average cost per compliance incident
compliance_cost_per_incident_usd.rationale: Remediation, complaint handling, legal and goodwill; excludes fines for serious breaches.

small_language_contact_share.label: Contacts in small-language or off-hours queues
small_language_contact_share.rationale: 8 markets: smaller languages cannot be pooled and need 24/7 or follow-the-sun cover.

fragmentation_overhead_pct.label: Staffing overhead caused by queue fragmentation
fragmentation_overhead_pct.rationale: Extra agents needed because small queues pool poorly (Erlang effect) and need minimum cover.

ai_containment_pct.label: AI verified resolution of AI-first contacts (mature)
ai_containment_pct.rationale: About 55 % of contacts are Tier-1 transactional or informational (order status, delivery changes, returns, simple billing, policy FAQ) x about 55 % verified resolution of those. Only verified outcomes count. Gartner predicts agentic AI will autonomously resolve 80 % of common issues by 2029; Gartner also found only 14 % of issues fully resolved in self-service in 2023 - hence a deliberately modest base.
ai_containment_pct.source: Assumption; Gartner press releases 5 Mar 2025 and 19 Aug 2024.

aht_reduction_pct.label: AHT reduction on human-handled contacts
aht_reduction_pct.rationale: Auto wrap-up removes about half of after-call work (about 10 points of AHT at 20 % ACW) plus assist and handoff-context effects. Brynjolfsson, Li and Raymond (QJE 2025) measured +15 % issues resolved per hour from a GenAI assistant in 5,172 support agents.
aht_reduction_pct.source: Assumption; Brynjolfsson, Li, Raymond, 'Generative AI at Work', QJE 140(2), 2025.

tier1_aht_factor.label: Handle time of contained contacts vs average
tier1_aht_factor.rationale: Contacts the AI resolves are simpler than average; savings use 85 % of the average cost per contact.

repeat_reduction_pct.label: Reduction of repeat contacts through QA, coaching and VoC
repeat_reduction_pct.rationale: 100 % QA and contact-driver analytics remove avoidable repeat contacts.

qa_effort_reduction_pct.label: Manual QA effort removed by auto-QA
qa_effort_reduction_pct.rationale: Analysts shift from scoring to calibration and coaching; only part is cashable.

attrition_reduction_pp.label: Attrition reduction from less repetitive work and assist
attrition_reduction_pp.rationale: Four points on a 40 % base (10 % relative).

abandon_reduction_pct.label: Reduction of abandoned voice contacts in AI-first queues
abandon_reduction_pct.rationale: The AI answers instantly at any volume.

margin_per_recovered_contact_usd.label: Gross margin protected per recovered abandoned contact
margin_per_recovered_contact_usd.rationale: About 10 % of abandoned contacts carry an order, a return or a retention risk worth about $60 of margin.

churn_reduction_pp.label: Customer churn reduction from better service

ai_overflow_absorption_pct.label: Overflow volume absorbed by the AI
ai_overflow_absorption_pct.rationale: Peaks are dominated by Tier-1 where-is-my-order and delivery-change contacts.

compliance_risk_reduction_pct.label: Compliance-incident reduction (100 % monitoring, real-time prompts, PII redaction)

ai_pooling_recovery_pct.label: Fragmentation overhead removed by multilingual AI and agent translation
ai_pooling_recovery_pct.rationale: AI covers small languages and off-hours; real-time translation lets agents serve pooled queues.

qa_coverage_target.label: Auto-QA coverage target (share of contacts scored)
qa_coverage_target.rationale: Product design target is 100 %; the calculator can lower it to see the cost effect.

confidence_containment.label: Confidence: containment savings are realised in cash
confidence_containment.rationale: Realisation risk: capacity released must be converted into attrition-based reductions, hiring freezes or redeployment.

confidence_aht.label: Confidence: AHT savings are realised in cash

confidence_revenue.label: Confidence: abandonment, CSAT and retention revenue effect

confidence_multilingual.label: Confidence: multilingual pooling
confidence_multilingual.rationale: Depends on language quality per market.

adoption_ramp.label: Share of contacts routed AI-first (average in year)
adoption_ramp.rationale: Pilot of 50 seats, then queue-by-queue expansion: roughly a quarter of contacts AI-first on average in Y1, 85 % in Y3 (some complex, regulated or VIP queues stay human-first).

maturity_ramp.label: AI performance maturity (share of mature resolution rate)
maturity_ramp.rationale: Knowledge, tools and prompts improve through the evaluation loop.

assist_ramp.label: Share of human-handled contacts with Agent Assist and auto wrap-up

qa_ramp.label: Auto-QA rollout (share of target coverage)
qa_ramp.rationale: Offline analytics scale faster than live channels.

ramp_other.label: Ramp for revenue, peak, compliance and multilingual benefits

discount_rate.label: Discount rate
discount_rate.rationale: Typical corporate hurdle rate; replace with the customer's WACC.

implementation_months.label: Build + pilot duration before go-live (Year 0)
implementation_months.rationale: About 3 months integration and knowledge preparation plus a 3-month pilot. Payback is reported from project start.

pilot_months.label: Pilot duration with live Azure consumption
pilot_months.rationale: Pilot seats run on a pilot-tier Azure footprint.

pilot_maturity.label: AI maturity during the pilot
pilot_maturity.rationale: Half of the mature resolution rate.

implementation_fixed_usd.label: Implementation: fixed (architecture, security review, integrations, knowledge, evaluation set-up)
implementation_fixed_usd.rationale: Systems-integrator effort for CRM/OMS, telephony and SBC, KB curation, evaluation harness and security review.
implementation_fixed_usd.source: Assumption; Gartner (2022) put conversational-AI integration at $1,000-$2,000 per agent, our total is within that range.

implementation_per_seat_usd.label: Implementation: per seat in scope
implementation_per_seat_usd.rationale: Queue onboarding, per-queue knowledge and tool configuration.

change_mgmt_per_agent_usd.label: Change management and training per agent
change_mgmt_per_agent_usd.rationale: Training for agents, supervisors, QA analysts; communications.

ai_ops_fte.label: AI operations team (conversation design, knowledge, evaluation, policy)
ai_ops_fte.rationale: Running an AI-first service is a product discipline: prompts, knowledge, evaluation gates, release management.

ai_ops_cost_per_fte_usd.label: Fully-loaded cost per AI-operations FTE
ai_ops_cost_per_fte_usd.rationale: Specialist salary level in European markets.

third_party_run_usd_per_seat_year.label: Third-party licences, SBC and telephony interop per seat in scope
third_party_run_usd_per_seat_year.rationale: Session border controller or cloud SBC, connectors, evaluation tooling; existing CCaaS seat licences are unchanged.

support_pct_of_implementation.label: Annual support and maintenance as share of implementation

azure_usage_multiplier.label: Azure consumption stress factor (applies to every Azure line)
azure_usage_multiplier.rationale: Use to stress-test unit prices or consumption (for example +50 %); 1.0 = list price at modelled usage.

nonprod_environment_uplift_pct.label: Non-production environments uplift on fixed platform items
nonprod_environment_uplift_pct.rationale: Dev, test and staging copies of search, analytics, gateway and compute.

openai_deployment_type.label: Azure OpenAI deployment type for price selection
openai_deployment_type.rationale: EU Data Zone Standard keeps processing in the EU and lists about 10 % above Global Standard.
openai_deployment_type.source: Azure Retail Prices API (DZ vs Gl meters).

voice_min_per_contained_contact.label: AI voice minutes per AI-resolved voice contact
voice_min_per_contained_contact.rationale: Greeting, language detection, OTP, order lookup, policy, action, confirmation.

voice_min_per_escalated_contact.label: AI voice minutes per voice contact that is not resolved by the AI
voice_min_per_escalated_contact.rationale: Greeting, triage, authentication, attempt, then warm handoff.

audio_in_tokens_per_sec.label: Realtime audio input tokens per second of speech
audio_in_tokens_per_sec.rationale: Microsoft Learn estimates about 10 tokens per second of input audio for Azure OpenAI models.
audio_in_tokens_per_sec.source: Microsoft Learn, Voice Live API: token usage and cost estimation (accessed 2026-11-17).

audio_out_tokens_per_sec.label: Realtime audio output tokens per second of speech
audio_out_tokens_per_sec.rationale: About 20 tokens per second of output audio.
audio_out_tokens_per_sec.source: Microsoft Learn, Voice Live API: token usage and cost estimation (accessed 2026-11-17).

rt_customer_speech_share.label: Share of call time the customer speaks (committed to the model)
rt_customer_speech_share.rationale: Server VAD commits only speech segments.

rt_agent_speech_share.label: Share of call time the AI agent speaks

rt_turns_per_min.label: Model responses per call minute
rt_turns_per_min.rationale: A response every 12 seconds; every response re-reads the cached context.

rt_avg_audio_context_tokens.label: Average audio context re-read per response
rt_avg_audio_context_tokens.rationale: A 4.5-minute call accumulates about 3,600 audio tokens; half on average.

rt_system_tokens.label: System prompt and tool schemas per response (cached text)

rt_reasoning_tokens_per_turn.label: Reasoning and text output tokens per response
rt_reasoning_tokens_per_turn.rationale: Realtime 2.x models reason; effort set to minimal or low.
rt_reasoning_tokens_per_turn.source: Assumption; Microsoft Learn GPT Realtime 2.1 overview.

rt_tool_text_in_tokens_per_min.label: Tool-result text tokens per call minute

rt_full_model_share.label: Share of voice minutes on gpt-realtime-2.1 (rest on -mini)
rt_full_model_share.rationale: Mini for routine Tier-1 calls; full model for hard languages, complex cases and escalation-prone intents.

rt_fallback_pipeline_share.label: Share of AI voice minutes on the STT-LLM-TTS fallback pipeline
rt_fallback_pipeline_share.rationale: Resilience path used when the realtime service or a language is unavailable.

speech_text_tokens_per_min.label: Text tokens produced per minute of speech
speech_text_tokens_per_min.rationale: About 150 words per minute at 1.3 tokens per word.
speech_text_tokens_per_min.source: Assumption; Microsoft Q&A estimate of 185-220 tokens per minute.

tts_chars_per_speech_min.label: Synthesised characters per minute of agent speech
tts_chars_per_speech_min.rationale: About 150 words per minute at 6.5 characters per word.

talk_share_of_aht.label: Talk time as share of voice AHT (rest is wrap-up)

human_leg_anchored_share.label: Share of escalated voice calls whose human leg stays anchored on the communications platform
human_leg_anchored_share.rationale: The rest is transferred by SIP REFER to the customer's existing CCaaS (the platform leg ends; recording and assist then come from the CCaaS media fork).

comms_azure_billed_share.label: Share of communications spend billed through Azure meters (counts as ACR)
comms_azure_billed_share.rationale: Azure Communication Services is retiring as a standalone offering on 30 Sep 2028 and new customers cannot acquire ACS numbers or SMS since 23 Oct 2026, so the base case treats voice legs, chat, SMS, e-mail and messaging as billed by SIP/CPaaS providers, Teams Phone or Dynamics 365 (customer cost, not Azure ACR). Set to 1.0 for a tenant that already runs on ACS (existing resource created before 23 Oct 2026) or for Teams-aligned Call Automation scenarios.
comms_azure_billed_share.source: Microsoft Learn, Retirement and breaking changes guide for Azure Communication Services (accessed 2026-11-17).

chat_turns_per_contained_contact.label: AI turns per AI-resolved digital contact
chat_turns_per_contained_contact.rationale: Identify, authenticate, look up, decide, confirm.

chat_turns_per_escalated_contact.label: AI turns per digital contact that is not resolved by the AI

chat_uncached_in_tokens_per_turn.label: Chat: uncached input tokens per turn
chat_uncached_in_tokens_per_turn.rationale: New message, tool results, retrieved chunks.

chat_cached_in_tokens_per_turn.label: Chat: cached input tokens per turn

chat_out_tokens_per_turn.label: Chat: output tokens per turn (incl. reasoning)

digital_mix_chat.label: Digital mix: web chat
digital_mix_chat.rationale: Mix of digital contacts by channel (sums to 1).

digital_mix_messaging.label: Digital mix: messaging apps (WhatsApp-class)
digital_mix_messaging.rationale: Mix of digital contacts by channel.

digital_mix_email.label: Digital mix: e-mail
digital_mix_email.rationale: Mix of digital contacts by channel.

human_digital_messages_per_contact.label: Messages exchanged in an escalated digital contact (human part)
human_digital_messages_per_contact.rationale: Counted only for the share anchored on ACS.

assist_calls_per_human_voice_contact.label: Agent Assist LLM calls per human voice contact
assist_calls_per_human_voice_contact.rationale: One suggestion refresh per customer turn.

assist_calls_per_human_digital_contact.label: Agent Assist LLM calls per human digital contact

assist_uncached_in_tokens.label: Assist: uncached input tokens per call
assist_uncached_in_tokens.rationale: Transcript window and retrieved policy chunks.

assist_cached_in_tokens.label: Assist: cached input tokens per call

assist_out_tokens.label: Assist: output tokens per call
assist_out_tokens.rationale: Next-best-action and a suggested reply with citations.

qa_uncached_in_tokens.label: Auto-QA: uncached input tokens per conversation
qa_uncached_in_tokens.rationale: Transcript of about 1,000 words plus metadata.

qa_cached_in_tokens.label: Auto-QA: cached input tokens per conversation (rubric)

qa_full_model_share.label: Share of QA scoring (or re-scoring) on gpt-5.4 instead of gpt-5.4-mini

classify_calls_per_contact.label: Classification calls per contact (intent, sentiment, risk)
classify_calls_per_contact.rationale: Per-turn classification on the nano model.

embed_tokens_per_contact.label: Embedding tokens per analysed contact (VoC clustering)

eval_conversations_per_month.label: Evaluation and red-team conversations per month
eval_conversations_per_month.rationale: Regression gate on every change plus nightly suites.

eval_in_tokens_per_conversation.label: Evaluation: input tokens per simulated conversation

eval_out_tokens_per_conversation.label: Evaluation: output tokens per simulated conversation

language_records_per_contact.label: Language service text records per analysed contact (PII + sentiment)
language_records_per_contact.rationale: A 1,000-word transcript is about 5 records of 1,000 characters; two features.

content_safety_records_per_ai_contact.label: Content Safety text records per AI-first contact
content_safety_records_per_ai_contact.rationale: Prompt Shields on user text and documents, output moderation, groundedness checks.

content_safety_records_per_assisted_cont.label: Content Safety text records per assisted human contact

search_queries_per_assisted_contact.label: Search queries per assisted human contact

search_qps_per_replica.label: Search queries per second per S1 replica
search_qps_per_replica.rationale: Hybrid + semantic ranking on a small index; validate with a load test.

otp_required_share.label: Share of AI-first contacts that need OTP verification
otp_required_share.rationale: Account-specific requests need verification; FAQ-type contacts do not.

otp_sms_share.label: OTP delivered by SMS
otp_sms_share.rationale: SMS is the most expensive channel; e-mail and app push are used where possible.

otp_email_share.label: OTP delivered by e-mail
otp_email_share.rationale: Remainder uses app push or existing sessions (no Azure cost).

confirmation_sms_share_of_resolved.label: Resolved contacts that receive a confirmation SMS

confirmation_email_share_of_resolved.label: Resolved contacts that receive a confirmation e-mail

keyvault_ops_per_ai_contact.label: Key Vault operations per AI-first contact
keyvault_ops_per_ai_contact.rationale: Token refresh and secret reads (managed identity reduces this).

peak_to_average_factor.label: Peak-to-average load (calendar average)
peak_to_average_factor.rationale: Daily peak hour about 2x operating-hour average, operating about 14 of 24 hours, seasonal peak about 1.5x.

voice_sessions_per_vcpu.label: Concurrent voice relay sessions per vCPU
voice_sessions_per_vcpu.rationale: I/O-bound WebSocket relay of 24 kHz PCM16 audio; validate with a load test.

worker_vcpu_per_1000_seats.label: Background worker vCPU per 1,000 seats in scope (QA, wrap-up, analytics)

platform_base_vcpu.label: Base platform vCPU per region (API, router, consoles)

compute_headroom.label: Compute headroom (N+1 and burst)
compute_headroom.rationale: Spare capacity for failover and bursts.

requests_per_contact.label: HTTP requests per contact (SPA, API, polling)

cosmos_ru_per_contact.label: Cosmos DB request units per contact
cosmos_ru_per_contact.rationale: Session state, memory, turns, tool audit, QA record, wrap-up.

cosmos_peak_factor.label: Cosmos DB peak-to-average RU/s
cosmos_peak_factor.rationale: Autoscale maximum is sized for peaks.

cosmos_autoscale_avg_utilisation.label: Average autoscale utilisation of the maximum RU/s
cosmos_autoscale_avg_utilisation.rationale: Autoscale bills the highest scaled RU/s per hour (minimum 10 % of the maximum).
cosmos_autoscale_avg_utilisation.source: Assumption; Azure Cosmos DB autoscale billing.

cosmos_retention_days.label: Cosmos DB hot retention window
cosmos_retention_days.rationale: Older data moves to the lake.

recording_mb_per_min.label: Recording size per minute (compressed stereo)
recording_mb_per_min.rationale: Stereo MP3 at 64 kbps is about 0.48 MB per minute.

recording_hot_days.label: Recording hot-tier retention
recording_hot_days.rationale: Quick access for QA and disputes.

recording_retention_months.label: Total recording retention
recording_retention_months.rationale: Set per market consent and retention rules (GDPR storage limitation).

transcript_kb_per_contact.label: Transcript and artefact storage per contact

storage_transactions_uplift_pct.label: Storage transaction charges as share of capacity charges

fabric_cu_per_seat.label: Fabric capacity units per seat in scope
fabric_cu_per_seat.rationale: Eventhouse, lakehouse and semantic-model load; size with the Fabric capacity metrics app in the pilot.

events_per_contact.label: Streaming events per contact
events_per_contact.rationale: Turn, tool, routing and metric events.

telemetry_kb_per_contact.label: Logs, traces and metrics per contact

global_contact_center_agents.label: Contact-center agents worldwide
global_contact_center_agents.rationale: Gartner's 2022 estimate of approximately 17 million contact-center agents worldwide.
